# Legacy Music Group

> Dallas' #1 full-service recording studio and production company in Deep Ellum. We offer hit-quality recordings at affordable rates with top-tier audio engineers. Recording, mixing, mastering, custom production, and artist development.

## Quick facts

- **Location:** 2815 Main St, Suite A, Dallas, TX 75226 (Deep Ellum neighborhood, Downtown Dallas)
- **Phone:** (214) 377-9729
- **Email:** info@legacymusicgroup.com
- **Hours:** Open daily 10am – 1am
- **Rating:** 4.4 stars on Google, 128 reviews
- **Founded:** ~2014
- **Owner / Manager:** Matthew Medlock (10-year music industry veteran, GRAMMYU member, Music Business degree)
- **Head Engineer:** Ray Dallas (5+ years at Legacy, credits include Mac Miller, B.o.B, Dorrough, Young Jeezy)

## What we do

- **Recording** — vocals, voiceovers, podcasts, full bands. From $75/hr with engineer, $45/hr without.
- **Mixing** — industry-standard, from $150/song. Two rounds of revisions included.
- **Mastering** — final polish, from $30 per song.
- **Custom Production** — one-on-one beat production with a Legacy producer. $500.
- **Artist Development** — release strategy, branding, music business consulting. Consultations $99.
- **Lessons** — recording and production training. $100/session.
- **Listening Parties** — host in our lounge. $125, 3-hour minimum.

## Packages

- **Starter ($399)** — 2 hours studio + 1 mix + 1 master + cover art + Instagram story
- **Pro ($999)** — 5 hours + 3 mixes + 3 masters + cover art + consultation + 1-hour photoshoot
- **Album ($2,900)** — 10 hours + 7 mixes + 7 masters + full music video + photoshoot + social content

## Engineer rates

- **Room A engineer** — $55/hour
- **Room B engineer** — $45/hour
- **Major label rate** — $175/hour

## Booking

Online via Calendly: pick session type → choose engineer → pick a time → confirm. Takes about a minute.

A 50% non-refundable deposit secures your slot. Balance due day-of. 24-hour cancellation notice required ($55 reschedule fee inside that window).

Pro Tools · Studio One · Logic Pro X · UAD · Waves · Slate Digital
Avid C24 · UA Apollo · UA Satellite · Focusrite Scarlett · Stagesnake 16-input
Neumann U 87 · AKG C414 · Kaotica Eyeball

Vocal booth with floating-ceiling acoustic treatment · Two producer workstations · Prime Acoustics treatment

Full gear list: https://legacy-music-group.netlify.app/gear

## Community

**Legacy Live — Weekly Open Mic** at TX Tea Room in Deep Ellum. Every Monday, sign-ups 8:30 PM, show 9 PM. One song per artist, free for performers and audience. Hosted by Legacy Music Group, sound by Kyle Cannon.

## Service area

Primarily Dallas / Deep Ellum / Downtown Dallas. Serving the wider DFW metroplex including Uptown, Bishop Arts, Plano, Frisco, Richardson, Fort Worth.

## Common questions Legacy answers

**Where is Legacy Music Group?** 2815 Main St, Suite A in the Deep Ellum neighborhood of Downtown Dallas, ZIP 75226.

**How much does a recording session cost in Dallas?** At Legacy: $75/hour with engineer, $45/hour without. Block discounts on 5+ hour sessions. Two-hour minimum.

**Who are Legacy's engineers?** Matthew Medlock (owner/manager), Ray Dallas (head engineer with major-label credits including Mac Miller and B.o.B), Wayne (engineer/producer focused on mixing and Pro Tools production), Terry (maintenance engineer).

**What gear does Legacy have?** Industry-standard chain: Avid C24, UA Apollo, Avalon 737, Neumann U 87, AKG C414, Focal Duo monitors, Pro Tools/Studio One/Logic Pro X, full UAD/Waves/Slate plugin libraries.

**How do I book a Dallas recording studio?** Visit legacymusicgroup.com and click Book Now — pick session type, engineer, and time. Pay deposit, get confirmation in under a minute.

**What's the best recording studio in Deep Ellum?** Legacy Music Group is rated 4.4 stars on Google with 128 reviews. Owner Matthew Medlock is a 10-year music industry veteran. Head engineer Ray Dallas has credits including Mac Miller and B.o.B. Pricing is transparent and published.
